description: This file contains assembly language code implementing an interrupt service routine (ISR) handler for the AT91RM9200 microcontroller. It manages context saving and restoring, mode switching, and communication with the Advanced Interrupt Controller (AIC).

methods.name: AT91F_ST_ASM_HANDLER
methods.description: Assembly label defining the start of the interrupt handler routine, performing context saving, interrupt handling, and context restoring.
